Within it, the peaks fall on turn boundaries (the newline after a post, the speaker label and its colon, the first words of a reply such as 'Agreed', 'Thanks', 'No problem', 'But') and on the pieces of usernames. It stays near zero (<0.15 of max) on encyclopedic or expository prose, on narrative fiction and on ordinary code, even when the content words are the same, and activity grows the longer the discussion has gone on.
